description: This is a Java source file defining an Android Service class BluetoothLeService that manages Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) GATT connections, handling connection lifecycle, service discovery, characteristic reading, notifications, and data processing for a BLE device, particularly focusing on heart rate measurements.

classes.name: BluetoothLeService
classes.description: An Android Service to manage BLE GATT connection, data transfer, and profile handling.

classes.name: LocalBinder
classes.description: Binder class providing clients with the service instance.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects to a BLE device by address, reusing existing GATT if possible.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects from the current BLE device.

methods.name: readCharacteristic
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous read of a specified characteristic.

methods.name: setCharacteristicNotification
methods.description: Enables or disables notifications on a characteristic.

methods.name: getSupportedGattServices
methods.description: Returns list of GATT services supported by the connected device.
